rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Enables AI-assisted management and analysis of Red Hat Enterprise Linux infrastructure through the Red Hat Lightspeed platform. Provides tools for configuration assessment via Advisor, system image creation with Hosted Image Builder, inventory management, issue remediation workflows, and security vulnerability assessment.
